text:
Alice (Platform): heads-up — post-merge EU canary is showing a latency p95 spike and a small uptick in 5xx. I'm holding the rollout. Need an unwind/mitigation plan + release-note snippet.

DeployBot: alert: metric latency_p95_eu crossed threshold (2.1x) at 2024-05-03T03:12Z. autorevert suppressed by manual hold.

Ben (Eng Releases): copying in @Carla and @Dima. any quick signal on whether this is infra vs model change? suspect PR #8421 (kvcache tweak) from the diff.

Carla (SRE): logs show KV cache eviction errors on several eu-nodes starting ~03:10 UTC, correlates with the tag `cache/kv-bump`. 503s from gateway tied to cache misses. rolling back that change looks like lowest blast radius.

Dima (Product): ok — if we do manual unwind, we should prep a short note: "temporary rollback of EU canary due to latency regression; no data loss; investigating". I'll draft.

Alice (Platform): decision: execute manual unwind to last known good image (infra/app:2024-05-01-stable). keep the release branch frozen until postmortem. owners: Ben = exec, Carla = monitor, Eve = docs/comms, Dima = customer note.

Ben (Eng Releases): I'll run the rollback steps now. posting the plan here so we all have the sequence: 

```
1) set EU route weight -> 10% then 0% (routing UI)
2) deploy previous image to eu-prod: 
   kubectl -n eu-prod set image deployment/api api=infra/app:2024-05-01-stable
3) scale down any sidecars introduced by PR-8421 if present
4) watch p95 + 5xx for 10m (Carla monitors)
5) if metrics recover, ramp traffic back to 100% over 10m
6) open postmortem ticket and label release branch frozen
```

Carla (SRE): monitoring dashboard pinned. I'll watch these: `latency_p95_eu`, `5xx_rate_eu`, `kv_evictions_eu`. Will call out at first sign of degradation.

Eve (Support): prepping internal notes and an incident stub for the release notes page. Will link to CS playbook after Dima's draft.

Ben (Eng Releases): executing step 2 now. running: `kubectl -n eu-prod set image deployment/api api=infra/app:2024-05-01-stable` — ETA ~ 40s.

DeployBot: action: deployment initiated by Ben (Eng Releases) at 2024-05-03T03:18Z; rollout id r-20240503-1717000000-eu

DeployBot: status: rollout succeeded (all pods ready) at 2024-05-03T03:21Z.

Carla (SRE): initial check: p95 back down to baseline within 2m, 5xx dropped to expected. kv_evictions cleared. :thumbsup:

Dima (Product): drafting customer-facing line: "We temporarily reverted a canary rollout in the EU region after detecting increased latency. We’ve reverted to the previous stable image and are investigating the root cause. No customer data was affected." Will paste final in thread.

Eve (Support): posted internal note + stub incident: https://internal.redwood/status/INC-20240503-eu-canary. Adding Dima as reviewer.

Alice (Platform): great work. Action items:
- Ben: hold further merges to release branch until PM (don't merge hotfixes there without release lead)
- Carla: collect logs + KV traces, attach to ticket
- Dima & Eve: finalize customer/internal comms
- Ben/Alice: schedule postmortem Monday with runtime + SRE + product

Ben (Eng Releases): acknowledged. will also cherry-pick a rollback-safe fix branch for verification in staging (PR-8421-revert-test).

Carla (SRE): saving dashboards and exporting logs now. sending binlogs to ticket.

Alice (Platform): closing the manual unwind — monitoring for 30m then will mark the thread as stable. Thanks everyone :heart: 

Ben (Eng Releases): marking release tag v1.9.4 as rolled-back-for-eu and adding note to changelog.

DeployBot: note: autorevert rules remain suppressed for this thread per manual hold.

Alice (Platform): ok — postmortem Monday. If anything regresses in the meantime, ping @oncall-sre immediately.
